flavor: You kneel, and a cradle of roots lifts your companion as warmth drains from your hands.

details.label: Duration

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: No item needed unless named above.

body.text: Roots gently lift the fallen. Pay 3 HP first, leaving yourself above 0; cost bypasses resistance. Requires a free hand. Life resistance reduces healing, minimum 1.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: Restore 9 HP; the target may stand without spending movement.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Restore 13 HP; the target may stand without spending movement, then move 1 square without provoking.

notes.label: Offensive healing — latest agreement
notes.text: this spell may target an unwilling creature harmed by healing. Resolve it as an attack using its printed attribute, range, action and HP cost; the HP result becomes Life damage, without beneficial recovery riders. This is the explicit exception to willing-only targeting above. Use the creature’s printed defense when a player defends; no opposed second roll.

flavor: You touch your throat and feel the next breath come cool and easy beneath the surface.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self or one adjacent willing creature.

details.label: Duration
details.value: One hour; ends early if you replace it.

details.label: Limits
details.value: No HP is restored, so this is not a healing spell and has no Life-energy payment.

body.text: The target can breathe ordinary water and air for one hour. This does not change Speed, permit speech underwater, remove poison or protect against pressure or temperature. One recipient at a time from this card per caster; applying it again ends your previous application. Give the recipient a perceptible warning one minute before expiration.

flavor: You lift the crushed leaves, scatter the cold ash and leave the place looking as though it never held a story.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 2 progress; also learn which approach shows the clearest remaining trail.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 3 progress; gain both details and preserve one useful ordinary item found while cleaning, if any is present.

details.label: Duration
details.value: One scene; ends sooner if the summon reaches 0 HP or breaks its tether.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: No equipment, corpse or consumable supplied or required. Summoned forms and their inherent gear provide no permanent loot or free supplies.

details.label: Limits
details.value: One creature per casting; no total summon cap. No earlier summon card required. Only explicitly eligible bestiary entries can be selected; ordinary monster statistics or encounter CV alone do not establish eligibility.

body.text: Choose one bestiary entry explicitly approved for Fey summoning with a minimum summoning tier no higher than 1. Summon one instance of that creature. Choose anew each casting; this card does not bind you to one species. Use that entry’s summon profile for HP, resistance, size, Speed, senses and permitted abilities. Creature appearance alone grants none of these capabilities.

Immediately give the new summon one free Main command: it receives a Main Action and a Maneuver, with normal downward conversions. This counts as its one command on this turn. Further activity on later turns requires a paid command. Without a command it does nothing: no movement, following, attacks, aid, lookout, alerts or new ability use. An old order grants no ongoing activity.

The summon acts during your turn. It disappears immediately if it goes more than 6 squares from you, including through forced movement. It cannot summon other creatures or take independent Reactions. Apply Command a Summon and the summoning reference.

body.text: Choose Force’s intended result before rolling: obstacle progress, reducing your Grappled rating, or pushing a creature. Describe a plausible means of exerting force.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: 2 progress, Grappled reduction, or squares of push.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 3 progress, Grappled reduction, or squares of push.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 4 progress, Grappled reduction, or squares of push.

body.text: Afterward you may move up to 2 squares without provoking if able. Grappled 3 leaves no Main Action to spend; this cannot release a fully restrained user.
Stability: apply it only to the push option, not obstacle progress or Grappled reduction.

flavor: You wedge a boot where a tool should go, offer an unexpected comparison and somehow make the work easier.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One ally within 3 squares that can understand your Aid.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the aided roll or the start of your next turn.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Normal Aid action and group-check restrictions apply.

body.text: Your Aid reaches that ally and grants 2 Boons instead of 1 to the declared task’s next roll. Describe how your unusual method helps. It grants no missing specialist permission, extra crafting attempt or additional contribution to a group check.

flavor: You interrupt with a question, a spilled drink or an absurdly well-timed cough, and your companion moves while everyone looks at you.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One creature within 3 squares that can see or hear your distraction; one willing ally within 3 squares.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Movement is immediate; the Boon expires when used or the start of your next turn.

body.text: Describe a distraction the creature can perceive. The ally may move up to 2 squares without provoking from that creature. It also gains 1 Boon to its next roll against that creature before the start of your next turn. Other enemies can still react to the movement. This does not compel belief or grant Hidden.

flavor: You catch a companion by the sleeve and stumble away together, leaving the next blow aimed at suddenly empty ground.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and one adjacent willing ally, after an attack against either of you resolves.

body.text: You and that ally may each move up to 2 squares without provoking. Choose the order and legal free endpoints. Each must still be able to move. The triggering attack has already resolved; this provides no retroactive protection.

flavor: You step your guard into the line of the strike and wave your companion behind you as it lands.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One adjacent willing ally, after a single-target attack is declared against it but before rolling.

details.label: Duration
details.value: The triggering attack and immediate ally movement.

body.text: Become the target if you meet the attack’s range and targeting requirements. Resolve the attack once against you; your ally receives none of its effects. Afterward the ally may move up to 2 squares without provoking if able. You do not move to intercept and cannot redirect an area attack.

flavor: You absorb the hit and answer with a hard shove, stepping forward as the attacker stumbles away.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One adjacent enemy, after it damages you.

body.text: Push it up to 2 squares directly away from you, then you may move 1 square toward it without provoking. Use legal routes and a free endpoint. The damage already taken remains; normal collision rules apply.

flavor: You hurry to a companion’s side and turn outward, ready to meet whatever followed them.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Movement is immediate; Defend ends at the start of your next turn.

body.text: Move up to 2 squares toward that ally without provoking. If you end adjacent to it, gain Defend’s 1 Boon to defense until the start of your next turn. This is the ordinary Defend benefit and does not multiply an existing Defend.

flavor: You see the blow gathering over your companion and charge into its path, driving them back behind your shoulder.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing ally within 3 squares, after a single-target attack is declared against it but before any attack or defense roll.

details.label: Duration
details.value: The interception, attack and immediate ally movement.

body.text: Move up to 3 squares without provoking to a free square adjacent to the ally. You must then be a legal target of that attack. Become its target and resolve it once against you; gain 1 Boon if you make a defense roll. Afterward the ally may move up to 2 squares without provoking if able. If you cannot reach a legal interception position, you cannot use this card.
This is declared before the outcome is known. It neither transfers already-resolved damage nor redirects an area attack.

flavor: You brace and surge outward, forcing the surrounding enemies back while your companions scramble into the room you have made.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Every enemy adjacent when you begin; up to two willing allies initially within 2 squares.

body.text: Push each enemy 2 squares directly away from you, in an order you choose. Then each chosen ally may move up to 2 squares without provoking. The allies need legal routes and free endpoints. No direct damage; collisions resolve normally.

flavor: You draw a companion into the shelter of your stance and meet the next threat with both of you behind your guard.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and one adjacent willing ally.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the start of your next turn; adjacency is required for the ally.

body.text: Use Defend and extend its 1 Boon to that ally. Both benefits last until the start of your next turn; the ally must remain adjacent while you can act. The ally gains Stability 1 for the first forced movement during the ward, including joining a collision chain. Use the highest applicable Stability, maximum 3. Consume this grant after that event even if another source was higher. Reusing this card replaces the ward, not its spent Stability grant.

flavor: You settle your weight into the ground and draw your guard close, letting the shove spend itself against your stance.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self while your Defend is active.

body.text: Gain Stability 2 while your Defend is active. Use your highest applicable Stability, maximum 3. You still need to use Defend normally; this grants no resistance to damage.

flavor: You drop beside your fallen companion, steady their breathing and drag them behind your guard in one practiced motion.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Stabilization and relocation are immediate; your Defend ends at the start of your next turn.

body.text: Stabilize it, then move it up to 2 squares to a free square adjacent to you without provoking. You need a free hand and must be able to support its weight. Gain Defend until the start of your next turn. This restores no HP and removes no wound; it cannot interrupt Last Words.

flavor: You put yourself at the front and guide your companions through the press, keeping each dangerous opening behind your shoulder.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and up to two adjacent willing allies.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Movement is immediate; each defensive Boon expires when used, adjacency is lost or your next turn starts.

body.text: Move yourself and the chosen allies up to your Speed each without provoking, in an order you choose. Choose legal routes and separate free endpoints; the allies must finish adjacent to you. Each ally gains 1 Boon to its next defense before the start of your next turn while it remains adjacent to you and you can act. This does not carry an immobile creature or grant attacks.

flavor: You see the enemy stagger under a companion’s blow and dart in before they can gather themselves.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: A visible enemy within 3 squares, after another creature applies temporary Dazed, Blinded or Frightened to it.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate approach, attack and possible exit.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Requires a melee weapon for the attack; grants one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, if absent.

body.text: Move up to 2 squares toward that enemy without provoking. If you finish adjacent, make one free Basic Melee attack using Brawn; on Strong you may also move 1 square without provoking afterward. You need a melee weapon and must be able to attack. If the triggering condition came from a free attack, it cannot trigger this card’s free attack. No further free attacks arise from your attack.

flavor: You give ground without a sound, using the enemy’s reaching weapon to hide the direction of your first step.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate movement; Disengage lasts for this turn.

body.text: As part of Disengage, move up to 2 squares without provoking. This additional movement makes no audible footfalls but does not silence speech or deliberately used equipment. It does not grant Hidden in open view; actual concealment still matters.

flavor: You brush away the obvious prints, point out the stones that keep none and lead the party off the route their pursuers expect.

details.label: Time
details.value: Ten minutes preparation, then up to one hour of guided travel.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and up to six willing companions following your route outside combat.

details.label: Duration
details.value: The concealed trail remains difficult to follow until new evidence exposes it.

details.label: Limits
details.value: One application per departure; repeated preparation does not add more Banes.

body.text: Spend ten minutes preparing a departure from a campsite or other stopping place. Conceal ordinary traces of the departure and guide the group for up to one hour. Attempts to follow those ordinary tracks take 2 Banes. This does not erase magical marks, remove witnesses or conceal people from direct view. The protection ends where the party leaves your guidance or creates a conspicuous new trail.

flavor: You find the lock’s rhythm through the tool, work its stubborn point and ease it open without a click.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Lock tools required; grants one set, Bulk 1, if absent.

body.text: Use lock tools to work toward the DA’s stated opening target. Each attempt takes a Main Action, in or out of combat.
Your tool work makes no audible noise and leaves no tool marks. This does not silence the door or disarm a linked trap; the DA states any known risk before you begin.

flavor: You slip along the blind side of the struggle, ducking below a reach and stepping through the open space beyond.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self; a legal route of up to 3 squares.

body.text: Move up to 3 squares without provoking. Ignore the extra cost of difficult terrain during this move, but do not cross standing occupied squares or barriers. The movement grants no attack or automatic Hidden.

flavor: You vault the low rail and land on bent knees, catching your balance before a loose stone can rattle.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self; a visible supported free landing within 2 squares.

body.text: Jump to the destination without provoking. You may cross a gap or low obstacle but not a wall or an occupied standing creature’s square. Land standing without audible footfalls. This grants no protection from a separate fall and requires a landing you can reach within the printed distance.

flavor: Your strike lands and you slip away on its follow-through, already looking for the next patch of cover.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self, after your Main Action attack resolves.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once on your turn; no benefit from free attacks.

body.text: After any result, move up to 1 square without provoking. After a Standard or Strong result, move up to 3 squares instead. An attack from Hidden ends Hidden normally; this movement does not automatically hide you again.

flavor: You send a glance and a tiny distracting motion toward one side while your companion slips quietly toward the other.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing ally within 3 squares that can perceive your signal.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Movement is immediate; Boon expires when used or the start of your next turn.

body.text: Provide a plausible distraction that nearby observers can see or hear. The ally may move up to 2 squares without provoking and gains 1 Boon to its next roll to remain unnoticed before the start of your next turn. The movement itself grants no Hidden in open view.

flavor: You draw the surrounding shadow across your body like a cloak and slip away while your outline fades from sight.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the end of your next turn, or immediately after an ending action.

body.text: Shroud yourself from sight, then move up to 3 squares without provoking. Until the end of your next turn, you cannot be selected as a visible target. Attacks that do not require seeing you and areas covering your square can still affect you. You remain solid and audible; this grants no passage through barriers or occupied squares.

The shroud ends immediately after you make an attack, cast another spell or use a card on another creature. Your own movement does not end it. This card supplies its complete concealment effect; it does not require a separate Invisible condition or change anyone else’s detection rules.

flavor: You hurry to the fallen voice, keep a hand against the wound and draw your companion into the shelter beside you.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One ally within 3 squares, immediately after it enters Dying and its wound is resolved.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate approach, stabilization and optional extraction.

body.text: Move up to 3 squares without provoking to a free square adjacent to the ally, then Stabilize it. You may move the ally 1 square to another free square adjacent to you without provoking if you have a free hand and can support its weight. If no route reaches it, you cannot use this card. Restore no HP and remove no wound; Last Words cannot be interrupted.

flavor: You reach toward your companion as the blow lands, calling them back along the safe route you can see.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing ally within 4 squares, after it takes damage.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Movement is immediate; Boon expires when used or the start of your next turn.

body.text: If still able to move, the ally may move up to 3 squares toward you without provoking. If it ends adjacent to you, it gains 1 Boon to its next defense before the start of your next turn. The attack already resolved; this does not undo its damage or move a Dying or restrained creature.

flavor: You press an open hand toward the injury and give a measured surge of your own warmth, keeping your voice steady as the effort leaves you pale.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing creature within 3 squares, including self.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: A free hand; no item granted.

body.text: Pay 3 HP before rolling, bypassing all resistance and leaving yourself above 0. A free hand is required. Apply Life resistance to healing, minimum 1 while HP is missing, and never exceed maximum HP.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: Restore 10 HP and reduce temporary Bleeding by 1.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Restore 15 HP, reduce temporary Bleeding by 2 and temporary Dazed by 1.

body.text: This removes no wound or scar and does not restore Grit or reverse Last Words. It is a complete healing spell, not a modifier requiring another learned heal.

A willing creature explicitly harmed by healing instead takes the listed HP amount as Life damage, with normal resistance and minimum damage; apply no beneficial recovery riders. An unwilling creature harmed by healing can be targeted as described below.

notes.label: Offensive healing — latest agreement
notes.text: this spell may target an unwilling creature harmed by healing. Resolve it as an attack using its printed attribute, range, action and HP cost; the HP result becomes Life damage, without beneficial recovery riders. This is the explicit exception to willing-only targeting above. Use the creature’s printed defense when a player defends; no opposed second roll.

flavor: You kneel close, steady the trembling hands or bind the hurt, and talk your companion through the next breath.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self or one adjacent willing creature.

body.text: Choose one temporary condition on the target: Bleeding, Frightened or Poisoned. Reduce only that condition, minimum 0.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Reduce it by 3; the target may also move 1 square without provoking if able.

body.text: This restores no HP and does not remove starred sources or wound scars.

flavor: You steady your companion as warmth returns, guiding their first step away from the place where they fell.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing ally you have just restored HP to with a spell or potion.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate stand and movement after healing.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once on your turn; the ally must actually regain HP.

body.text: That ally may stand without spending movement, then move 1 square without provoking if able. This works even if it was above 0 HP before healing. It grants no extra HP, reduces no healing payment and cannot reverse Last Words.

flavor: You keep speaking as you move closer, giving the fading breath a familiar voice to follow.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing Dying ally within 3 squares that can hear you, when you use Stabilize.

body.text: Your Stabilize can reach that ally without touch. After stabilizing it, you may move 1 square toward it without provoking. Stabilize still costs a Maneuver, clears death marks and restores no HP. The wound remains; Last Words cannot be interrupted.

flavor: You meet their unfocused gaze, name something familiar and wait for their breathing to settle.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing creature within 3 squares that can hear you.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Reduction is immediate; the Boon expires when used or the start of your next turn.

body.text: Reduce its temporary Frightened or Dazed by up to 2, minimum 0. Choose one condition. The target also gains 1 Boon to its next defense before the start of your next turn. No HP restored, no starred condition removed, and no actions already spent are refunded.

flavor: You take their shaking hands and pour life into them, holding their gaze until the battlefield comes back into focus.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing creature within 3 squares, including self.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Healing and reductions are immediate; spent actions are not restored.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: A free hand; no item granted.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: Restore 8 HP and reduce temporary Dazed by 1.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: Restore 16 HP and reduce temporary Dazed by 1.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Restore 24 HP, reduce temporary Dazed by 2 and temporary Blinded by 1.

body.text: Remove no starred conditions or scars. No Grit restoration or reversal of Last Words. This is a complete spell; no earlier healing card is required.

flavor: You gather your companions with a few familiar words, steadying one trembling voice after another until they answer together.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and up to three willing allies within 3 squares that can hear you.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Reductions are immediate; Boons expire when used or the start of your next turn.

body.text: Each recipient chooses one temporary condition from Frightened, Dazed or Poisoned and reduces it by up to 2, minimum 0. Each also gains 1 Boon to its next defense before the start of your next turn. No HP restored, no starred source removed and no spent actions returned. A recipient without those conditions still gains the defensive Boon.

flavor: You wrench your shoulders free and crash back against the hands that tried to hold you.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self while Grappled 1 or 2, and one adjacent creature contributing to that grapple.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate release, push and possible step.

body.text: Reduce your Grappled rating by up to 2, removing actual contributions you choose and the matching burden on those grapplers. Then push one contributing adjacent grappler up to 2 squares directly away and move 1 square without provoking if now able. You must have retained a Maneuver; at Grappled 3 you cannot use this card.

flavor: You drive the target backward and finish the motion with a downward wrench that leaves them sprawled where they land.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One creature pushed by your Main Action attack or Force action.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once on your turn; no benefit from free attacks.

body.text: After that push resolves, you may knock the target prone even if it did not strike an obstruction. Then you may move 1 square toward it without provoking if a legal free square is available. This adds no collision damage and cannot create numbered Prone.

flavor: You hear the first crack, plant your feet and drive through the weak point with another heave.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Progress and any completed opening persist; movement is immediate.

body.text: Use Force to overcome the obstruction; the DA states its progress target and consequences before rolling.
If this completes the target, you may move up to 2 squares through the opened route without provoking. This affects no creature or grapple and cannot force an impossible structure.

flavor: You catch the struggling body, turn hard at the hips and release the whole tangle in a violent throw.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One adjacent creature, whether or not you already grapple it.

body.text: Release any Grappled contribution you maintain on the target, then roll Brawn. You must have a Main Action before releasing; this card cannot be used while you are Grappled 3.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: Deal 3 physical damage and push 1 square.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: Deal 4 physical damage, push 2 squares and knock prone.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Deal 6 physical damage, push 3 squares and knock prone.

body.text: No prior grappling card or existing hold is required. The DA judges whether your body can plausibly throw the target; use normal collision rules.

flavor: You spit out the dust, bark a laugh and surge to your feet before the enemy has finished enjoying the sight.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self, when you stand from Prone.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Standing cost is always changed; the Boon expires when used or this turn ends.

details.label: Limits
details.value: The Boon can be gained once on your turn; repeated standing does not stack it.

body.text: Standing costs 1 square of movement instead of 2. After standing on your turn, gain 1 Boon to your next Force action or Main Action melee attack before that turn ends. This grants no ability to stand while movement is prohibited.

flavor: You snarl at the pain and shove back into the attacker, following the stumble with another aggressive step.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One adjacent creature, after it damages you.

body.text: Push it up to 2 squares directly away, then you may move up to 2 squares toward it without provoking. Choose a legal route and free endpoint. The original damage remains; this adds no attack or direct damage beyond collisions.

flavor: You throw your arms wide and drive into the bodies around you, sending the whole front rank stumbling away.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Every enemy adjacent when you begin.

body.text: Roll Brawn once using the least favorable net Boons/Banes among the targets.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: Push each 2 squares directly away from you.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Push each 4 squares and knock each prone.

body.text: Resolve the targets in an order you choose. No direct damage; normal collisions apply.

flavor: You drive your shoulder into the resistance and keep pushing after the first step gives way.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One creature pushed by your Force action.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate additional push and following step.

body.text: Add 1 square to your Force push, on any result. You may then move 1 square directly toward the target without provoking if the square is free. This adds no grapple reduction or obstacle progress, and grants no attack.

flavor: You roar and charge into the opening, arriving with your whole weight behind the next blow.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Movement is immediate; Boon expires when used or this turn ends.

body.text: Move up to 3 squares toward that enemy. This movement provokes normally. Gain 1 Boon to your next Main Action melee attack this turn. You must actually move at least 1 square to gain the Boon.

flavor: You circle the camp, test the ground for water and point out the approaches before assigning the first watch.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: A possible resting place and up to six willing companions; ten minutes of examination.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Eight hours or until the group leaves.

details.label: Limits
details.value: One prepared resting place per Warden; preparing another ends the previous benefit.

body.text: Spend ten minutes examining an accessible resting place. Learn its exposed approaches and any local environmental danger that observable signs can reveal. Prepare a watch plan. For the next eight hours while remaining there, you and the chosen companions gain 1 Boon to consequential rolls noticing approaching danger. This grants no automatic detection, shelter, supplies, safe-place ruling or Grit recovery. Sleeping characters do not become awake observers.

flavor: You call out footholds and openings in a steady voice, guiding your companions through the broken ground before the enemy can close it.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Up to three willing allies visible within 4 squares, able to hear your directions and move.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Each ally moves once per use.

body.text: Each ally may move up to 3 squares along a legal route without provoking, ignoring difficult-terrain surcharges. Resolve them one at a time; each ends in a supported free square. This does not cross gaps, barriers or occupied standing creatures. Allies spend no actions.

flavor: You test the ground with your boot and offer a hand, bringing your companion onto the firm patch beside you.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and one adjacent willing ally able to move.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Each participant moves once per use.

body.text: Move up to 1 square, then the ally may move up to 1 square. Both movements ignore difficult-terrain surcharges and do not provoke. Each must follow a legal route and end in a separate supported free square. This does not cross gaps or standing creatures. The ally spends no action.

flavor: You loose your shot, watch the quarry turn and run to keep its path in view.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self, after your Main Action attack against one visible creature.

body.text: Once on your turn, after resolving a Standard or Strong Main Action attack, move toward one creature affected by it: up to 1 square on Standard, or 2 on Strong. This movement does not provoke. You must be able to move and follow a legal route; it grants no attack.

flavor: You point out the plates that overlap, the limb it favors and the moment its breath catches, telling your companions where to meet it.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One visible creature within 8 squares that you have seen perform an ability or leave physical evidence.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Facts remain known; each Boon ends when used or the scene ends.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once per creature per scene; repeated uses do not renew spent benefits.

body.text: Study the creature and name up to three willing allies within 5 squares who can hear you. The DA reveals two true, useful facts from its actual resistances, weaknesses or observed ability restrictions. If fewer exist, learn all that exist; invent none. Each chosen ally gains 1 Boon to its next roll acting against that creature this scene. This does not expose its thoughts, unseen location or an unobserved secret identity.

flavor: You kneel beside a bent stem, brush grit from a footprint and look toward the gap the travelers chose.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Accessible tracks or other physical signs you can examine for one minute.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Information remains known; the Boon ends when used or the scene ends.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once per set of signs; new evidence permits another use.

body.text: Examine the signs for one minute. Learn the direction of travel and one supported detail about the travelers, such as their number, gait or burden. If the signs cannot support either answer, learn what obscures them. Gain 1 Boon to your next roll following this trail this scene. Obvious tracks remain readable by anyone; this reveals no exact unseen location or evidence that does not exist.

flavor: You watch the first turn of their shoulders and cut toward their escape route before their footsteps fade.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One visible enemy within 5 squares when it begins voluntary movement.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Movement is immediate; the Boon ends when used or at the end of your next turn.

details.label: Limits
details.value: One Reaction per use; repeated uses do not multiply the unused Boon.

body.text: After that movement ends, move up to 3 squares toward its final position without provoking, if you can still see it. Gain 1 Boon to your next attack against it before the end of your next turn. You must be able to move; this grants no attack and does not reveal a creature that becomes Hidden.

flavor: You lift a thorny branch, find a foothold between the stones and turn to show your companion the way through.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and one willing ally initially adjacent.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Each participant moves once per use.

body.text: Move up to 3 squares along a legal route, ignoring difficult-terrain surcharges and without provoking. Then the ally may move up to 1 square with the same benefits, ending adjacent to you. Both must be able to move and finish in supported free squares. If the ally cannot reach a legal adjacent endpoint, it stays where it is. No gaps, barriers or occupied standing squares are crossed.

flavor: You read the turn of the beast’s weight and strike where its next step must fall, driving it toward the ground you chose.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One visible creature: adjacent with a melee weapon, or within 8 squares with a ranged weapon and ammunition.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Damage and movement are immediate; Slowed decays normally.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: On learning, choose one ordinary melee weapon or one ordinary ranged weapon with a d8 ammunition bundle; grant each chosen item only if absent. Each item is Bulk 1. Each use requires the equipment for its chosen attack mode.

body.text: Choose melee or ranged before rolling Knowledge. Make one attack.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: Deal 4 physical damage and push the target 1 square.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: Deal 5 physical damage and push it 2 squares.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Deal 7 physical damage, push it 3 squares and apply Slowed 2.

body.text: After resolving the attack, you may move 1 square without provoking. Ranged use checks ammunition once after the attack. These are complete outcomes; this card requires no earlier signature.

flavor: You see the breath gathering for a shout and move before the warning comes.

details.label: Duration

details.value: No equipment, corpse or consumable supplied or required. Summoned forms and their inherent gear provide no permanent loot or free supplies.

Choose anew each casting; this card does not bind you to one species. Use that entry’s summon profile for HP, resistance, size, Speed, senses and permitted abilities. Creature appearance alone grants none of these capabilities.

Immediately give the new summon one free Main command: it receives a Main Action and a Maneuver, with normal downward conversions. This counts as its one command on this turn. Further activity on later turns requires a paid command. Without a command it does nothing: no movement, following, attacks, aid, lookout, alerts or new ability use. An old order grants no ongoing activity.

flavor: You catch the rhythm of your companions’ steps and give them the next beat.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Two willing allies within 3 squares who hear you.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: No item needed unless named above.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

body.text: Each moves 1 square toward a visible enemy without provoking, one at a time. Their actions remain their own.

flavor: You trace the last arc and stand inside the promise you have made together.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the start of your next turn; each Stability grant is used once.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: No item needed unless named above.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

body.text: Until the start of your next turn, each gains 1 Boon to defense against spells. Each gains Stability 2 for the first forced movement against them, including collision chains; highest applicable Stability only, maximum 3. The grant is consumed after that event even if a higher Stability applied. The ward is not physical cover.

flavor: You follow a familiar sign to a side entrance, and someone inside recognizes how you knock.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: An inhabited settlement where an illicit network could plausibly operate; four hours.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Information and earned contacts persist; their circumstances may change.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Cannot invent a network in an empty ruin or repeatedly roll without pursuing a new lead.

body.text: Seek a willing contact for one specific clandestine service: an introduction, passage or a hiding place. The DA confirms a suitable provider could be found and states available leads, stakes and a progress target before rolling. Completion finds a willing provider if one exists, not free service or guaranteed loyalty. The price and risk must be stated before you accept.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: 1 progress; learn one local sign or custom actually used by the network.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 2 progress; also learn one requirement a potential contact publicly or privately communicates.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 3 progress; also identify a practical way to verify that contact’s stated offer.

flavor: You shake the bottle once, judge the color, and offer it with the confidence of long practice.

details.label: Time
details.value: Maneuver to administer; one hour per crafting attempt.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self or one adjacent willing creature.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Condition reduction is immediate; crafted supplies persist until used.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: One mixing kit, Bulk 1, if absent; both named recipes. No ingredients or finished tonic.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

body.text: Use the tonic — Maneuver. Use a prepared Clearing Tonic supply and a free hand. Another recipient spends a Reaction unless at 0 HP. Roll Knowledge, apply one result, then check the tonic’s inventory die.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: Reduce temporary Poisoned by 2 or Dazed by 1.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Reduce temporary Poisoned by 3 or Dazed by 2.

body.text: Choose one listed condition; reduce it no lower than 0. This restores no HP and does not remove starred conditions.

Brew — one hour per attempt. This card permits and grants Clearing Tonic and Travel Food recipes. With the recipe’s tools and ingredients, roll Knowledge: Weak raises one supply by 1 inventory step; Standard by 2; Strong by 3, capped by the recipe. Check carried ingredients after the attempt. No group crafting.

flavor: You touch the place they hurt you, and the mark answers in heat.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: A visible creature within 4 squares after it damages you.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: No item needed unless named above.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

body.text: The mark answers with heat. This attack cannot trigger further free attacks.

flavor: You open your hands to the circle, feeling your own warmth flow toward your friends.

details.label: Duration

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: No item needed unless named above.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

body.text: Offer your strength to the whole circle. Pay 7 HP once before rolling, bypassing resistance and remaining above 0; requires a free hand. Allocate the rolled healing pool among the targets as you choose, minimum 1 allocated per chosen target. Each applies Life resistance to its share, minimum 1 while missing HP.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Share 22 HP; each recipient may reduce temporary Poisoned by 1.

flavor: You have watched every feint. When they finally run, your shot is already waiting.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Gain one ordinary ranged weapon and one d8 ammunition bundle if absent; each Bulk 1. Check ammunition after every attack.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

body.text: Take the shot you were waiting for. Requires ranged weapon and ammunition; check supply. This attack cannot trigger additional free attacks.

flavor: You draw someone’s attention with a question while your other hand lifts the unattended key from the table.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One adjacent visible unattended object of Bulk 0 or 1.

details.label: Duration

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: No item needed unless named above.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

body.text: Name the object and describe your distraction. An unobserved accessible pickup needs no roll. When discovery has consequences, roll Guile:

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: Draw attention aside and gain 1 Boon to your next attempt to take this object before the end of your next turn. You have not taken it yet.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: Take the object into your free hand without immediate notice.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Take it without immediate notice and leave a harmless substitute you already hold.

body.text: An observer can notice the missing object later. This takes only unattended objects, never held or worn equipment.

flavor: You look from the broken ridge to the river and understand the journey waiting between them.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: A natural route visible from a vantage point; ten minutes examination.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the identified hazard is passed or you abandon the route.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Reexamining the same hazard does not refresh an expended Boon. No routine travel roll is introduced.

body.text: Identify one observable route hazard and an available way around it, if any. No roll. You and up to six companions who follow your chosen route gain 1 Boon each to their next consequential noncombat roll negotiating that hazard. Hidden dangers remain hidden; this neither finds absent resources nor reveals a route beyond what can be observed.

flavor: You recognize the instant from your dream and call the warning before it is too late.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition

details.label: Limits
details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

flavor: You spread your arms, and the roots answer as if the whole orchard had stirred in its sleep.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: Pull each 2 squares and apply Slowed 1.

outcomes.label: Strong

flavor: You spread your fingers and watch webbing form between them. When you enter the water, each stroke catches the current more firmly.

flavor: You hold the damaged fitting between your fingers. The metal warms and softens just enough for you to bend it back toward its proper shape.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 3 repair progress; leave no visible rough edge.

flavor: You watch who pours first, who waits, and which little gesture makes a stranger smile.

details.label: Limits

body.text: Learn one local courtesy actually demonstrated during your observation and whom it is appropriate to address first, if evident. No roll. flavor: You part the grass, examine the crushed stems and touch the cold ash, following the signs of those who stopped here before you.

details.label: Duration

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: Learn the direction of recent passage.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Also identify a distinctive trace useful for following that group.

flavor: You soften into a ribbon of clay and feel the narrow opening slide around you.

details.label: Limits

flavor: You close your fist, and the air falls with the thunder.

outcomes.text: 4 lightning damage and push 1 away from the center.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 6 lightning damage and push 2; the center target’s direction is your choice.

body.text: For a target standing in the center square, choose its push direction before resolving the displacement.

details.label: Limits

details.label: Limits

flavor: You spread your tools on a cloth and turn a stopping place into a workshop.

details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

body.text: Requires a known ordinary recipe. Grants craft tools if absent and two compatible ordinary recipe choices. Recipe defines materials, time and completion; no free materials.

flavor: You recognize one familiar root in the strange writing, and the next line begins to open.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

body.text: This translates the chosen text; it does not teach the whole language.

Before rolling, agree with the DA on what you are trying to accomplish and what is at risk. The DA states how much progress completes the task and whether progress carries over between attempts. Add the progress shown by your result. If the action has no uncertain consequence, resolve it without a roll.

outcomes.text: 1 progress toward interpreting its meaning; recognize the text’s evident purpose, such as warning, account or prayer, if the surviving words support it.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 2 progress and the same insight into the text’s purpose.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 3 progress and that insight; distinguish one literal phrase from metaphor.

flavor: You look across the empty space, breathe once, and trust the leap you have practiced all your life.

details.value: A visible unoccupied landing within 6 squares

details.label: Limits
details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

body.text: Choose a landing within the rolled distance. If none is safe, remain at the origin. This crosses gaps, not walls; it is not flight. Ordinary jumping remains available without this card.

flavor: You steady the injured limb and work with the patient care of someone who knows how much it hurts.

details.value: One hour per attempt; at most once per wound per day.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One wound listing Bone; one hour

details.label: Duration
details.value: Recovery progress persists for that wound; completed treatment removes only its listed treatable penalties.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Each wound can be treated only once per day across all healers.

Keep a running total for that wound. When the total reaches its recovery value, remove only the penalties it lists as treatable by this method. The scar and accumulated wound count remain. This restores no HP, regrows no missing body part and replaces no lost equipment. The same wound may be treated only once per day, even by different healers.

flavor: You clean away the traces of the element and tend the damaged flesh beneath them.
